data.one_liner: Converts HTML strings or DOM nodes to CommonMark‑compatible Markdown.
data.what_it_does: The package parses HTML and outputs Markdown according to configurable style options. It supports tables, custom conversion rules, and ignoring elements.
use_when: You need to render HTML content as Markdown in a Dart or Flutter app
You want configurable conversion (e.g., heading style, list markers)
avoid_when: You require full fidelity HTML rendering (images, complex layouts)
You need a streaming or incremental conversion API
strengths: Simple API with a single convert function
Customizable via style options, ignore list, and custom rules
weaknesses: Limited to basic HTML features; complex CSS or scripts are ignored
No streaming or async conversion support
